# CANDIDATE: RELAXED_EMA_RIBBON_FLIP_BEARISH_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-09-10  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Relaxing the EMA ribbon flip condition in BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON to allow entries when the ribbon is bearish-colored (Fast < Pivot < Slow) but not necessarily flipped from bullish on the same bar will increase trade count by capturing entries during sustained bearish ribbon periods. This may improve edge capture by adding more trades on winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) without significantly increasing losses on loser days, as the bearish ribbon condition remains a bearish regime filter.

## Mechanism

Current condition: Requires EMA ribbon to be bearish-colored (Fast < Pivot < Slow) AND flipped from bullish on the same bar (i.e., ribbon transition occurred on that bar).  
Proposed condition: Only requires EMA ribbon to be bearish-colored (Fast < Pivot < Slow) at entry time, regardless of same-bar flip. Entry trigger still requires ≥2 of: level rejection, EMA ribbon condition (now relaxed), confluence with multi-day/premarket structure. All other context filters (time, structure, VIX, volume, news, loss budget, ribbon spread ≥30c) remain unchanged.

3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no OOS/WF executed)

5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Whipsaw losses: entering on bearish ribbon without fresh flip may increase entries in choppy/range-bound markets.
   - Increased loser-day losses: if relaxation causes trades on 5/05/5/06/5/07 that lose money.
   - Reduced winner-day edge: if relaxation leads to suboptimal entries on 4/29/5/01 that lose more or win less.
   - Concentration risk: reliance on 5/04 extreme-vol day (as seen in historical BEAR_SCORE_7_RELAXATION failure).
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top5_pct of P&L.
